<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Laughing yellow character</title>
<style>
html, body { margin: 0; width: 216px; height: 216px; overflow: hidden; }
canvas { display: block; width: 216px; height: 216px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const size = 216;
const unit = 1 / 54;
const tilt = 0.145;
const tau = 2 * Math.PI;
const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, Math.cos(tilt), -Math.sin(tilt));
const forward = new THREE.Vector3(0, Math.sin(tilt), Math.cos(tilt));
const center = new THREE.Vector3(0, 118 * unit, 0);
const cameraBasis = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(
  new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), -tilt
);
const lerp = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const ease = (lo, hi, value) => THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(value, lo, hi);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
  preserveDrawingBuffer: true,
  antialias: true
});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(size, size);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NoToneMapping;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf4f6f4);
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2, 2, 2, -2, 0.1, 180);
ref.position.copy(center).addScaledVector(forward, 13);
ref.lookAt(center);

function point(x, y, depth) {
  return center.clone()
    .addScaledVector(up, (108 - y) * unit)
    .addScaledVector(forward, depth)
    .add(new THREE.Vector3((x - 108) * unit, 0, 0));
}

function group(parent, name, anchor = null) {
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name = name;
  if (anchor) {
    part.position.copy(anchor);
    if (parent.userData.anchor) part.position.sub(parent.userData.anchor);
    part.userData.anchor = anchor;
  }
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function light(color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const lamp = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  lamp.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(lamp);
}
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaef, 0xe2cbb0, 1.72));
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xf3e8d7, 0.12));
light(0xfff1d4, 2.02, -3.7, 6.2, 4.6);
light(0xf5f7ff, 0.59, 4.4, 2.1, 4.8);
light(0xffffff, 0.70, 2.3, 4.8, -4.0);

const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(140, 140), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    nearColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xd1d2d0) },
    farColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xf5f7f5) }
  },
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec3 worldPosition;
    void main() {
      vec4 world = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      worldPosition = world.xyz;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * world;
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    uniform vec3 nearColor;
    uniform vec3 farColor;
    varying vec3 worldPosition;
    float hash(vec2 p) {
      return fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p, vec2(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
    }
    float oval(vec2 p, vec2 center, vec2 extent) {
      vec2 q = (p - center) / extent;
      return exp(-dot(q, q));
    }
    void main() {
      vec2 p = worldPosition.xz;
      vec3 color = mix(nearColor, farColor, smoothstep(2.25, 10.9, -p.y));
      float shadow = 0.085 * oval(p, vec2(1.20, -1.17), vec2(1.67, 2.90));
      shadow += 0.085 * oval(p, vec2(0.34, -0.20), vec2(0.34, 0.43));
      shadow += 0.096 * oval(p, vec2(1.23, 0.04), vec2(0.42, 0.47));
      float clouds = sin(p.x * 1.8 + p.y * 0.83) * sin(p.y * 1.09 - p.x * 1.29);
      color *= 1.0 - shadow + 0.010 * clouds;
      color += (hash(gl_FragCoord.xy) - 0.5) * 0.016;
      gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
    }
  `
}));
floor.name = 'off-white studio floor';
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
floor.position.y = -0.30;
scene.add(floor);

const pigment = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.96 });
pigment.onBeforeCompile = shader => {
  shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
    .replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>\nvarying vec3 pilePosition;')
    .replace('#include <begin_vertex>', '#include <begin_vertex>\npilePosition = position;');
  shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
    .replace('#include <common>', `
      #include <common>
      varying vec3 pilePosition;
      float pileHash(vec3 p) {
        p = fract(p * 0.3183099 + vec3(0.13, 0.31, 0.71));
        p *= 17.0;
        return fract(p.x * p.y * p.z * (p.x + p.y + p.z));
      }
      float pileNoise(vec3 p) {
        vec3 i = floor(p);
        vec3 f = fract(p);
        f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
        return mix(
          mix(mix(pileHash(i), pileHash(i + vec3(1,0,0)), f.x),
              mix(pileHash(i + vec3(0,1,0)), pileHash(i + vec3(1,1,0)), f.x), f.y),
          mix(mix(pileHash(i + vec3(0,0,1)), pileHash(i + vec3(1,0,1)), f.x),
              mix(pileHash(i + vec3(0,1,1)), pileHash(i + vec3(1,1,1)), f.x), f.y),
          f.z);
      }
    `).replace('#include <color_fragment>', `
      #include <color_fragment>
      vec3 nap = pilePosition * vec3(75.0, 48.0, 75.0);
      float mottle = pileNoise(pilePosition * 15.0) - 0.5;
      float grain = pileNoise(nap) - 0.5;
      float fine = pileNoise(nap * 2.31 + 9.0) - 0.5;
      diffuseColor.rgb *= 1.0 + 0.10 * mottle + 0.24 * grain + 0.12 * fine;
    `);
};
const palmMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.91 });
const cavityMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true });
const gold = new THREE.Color(0xc99a28);
const honey = new THREE.Color(0xd2a83a);
const paleGold = new THREE.Color(0xd8b744);
const ochre = new THREE.Color(0xa97522);
const biscuit = new THREE.Color(0xc4a17b);
const cream = new THREE.Color(0xd1b28e);
const darkPalm = new THREE.Color(0x41382a);
const backOfHand = new THREE.Color(0x554834);

function sampleRows(rows, fraction) {
  const u = fraction * (rows.length - 1);
  const i = Math.min(rows.length - 2, Math.floor(u));
  const t = u - i;
  const before = rows[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
  const start = rows[i];
  const end = rows[i + 1];
  const after = rows[Math.min(rows.length - 1, i + 2)];
  return start.map((v, k) => {
    const e = end[k];
    const m0 = (e - before[k]) * 0.5;
    const m1 = (after[k] - v) * 0.5;
    return v + t * (m0 + t * (3 * (e - v) - 2 * m0 - m1 +
      t * (2 * (v - e) + m0 + m1)));
  });
}

function ringGeometry(length, around, sample, flip = false, cap = false) {
  const positions = [];
  const colors = [];
  const indices = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < length; r++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < around; i++) {
      const { p, c } = sample(r / (length - 1), i / around);
      positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    }
  }
  for (let r = 0; r < length - 1; r++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < around; i++) {
      const a = r * around + i;
      const b = r * around + (i + 1) % around;
      const c = a + around;
      const d = b + around;
      if (flip) indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
      else indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
    }
  }
  if (cap) {
    const end = (length - 1) * around;
    for (let i = 1; i < around - 1; i++) {
      indices.push(0, i + 1, i, end, end + i, end + i + 1);
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return geometry;
}

function mesh(parent, name, geometry, material) {
  const result = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  result.name = name;
  parent.add(result);
  return result;
}

function addMorphs(geometry, positions) {
  const work = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  work.setIndex(geometry.index);
  geometry.morphAttributes.position = positions;
  geometry.morphAttributes.normal = positions.map(attribute => {
    work.setAttribute('position', attribute);
    work.deleteAttribute('normal');
    work.computeVertexNormals();
    return work.getAttribute('normal');
  });
}

const movingSkins = [];

function loft(parent, name, rows, tint, options = {}) {
  const { length = 61, around = 64, material = pigment, shapes = [] } = options;
  const anchor = parent.userData.anchor;
  function ringPoint(row, angle, f) {
    const [x, y, depth, width, thickness] = row;
    const edge = material === pigment
      ? 1 + 0.003 * Math.sin(angle * 17 + f * 116) * Math.sin(angle * 23 - f * 151)
      : 1;
    return point(
      x + Math.cos(angle) * Math.max(0.015, width) * edge,
      y,
      depth + Math.sin(angle) * Math.max(0.015, thickness) * edge * unit
    ).sub(anchor);
  }

  const baseRings = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => sampleRows(rows, i / (length - 1)));
  const geometry = ringGeometry(length, around, (f, turn) => {
    const row = baseRings[Math.round(f * (length - 1))];
    const angle = turn * tau;
    return {
      p: ringPoint(row, angle, f),
      c: tint(row[0] + Math.cos(angle) * row[3], row[1], angle, f)
    };
  }, false, true);

  if (shapes.length) {
    const targets = shapes.map(shape => {
      const positions = [];
      for (let r = 0; r < length; r++) {
        const f = r / (length - 1);
        const row = sampleRows(shape, f);
        for (let i = 0; i < around; i++) {
          const p = ringPoint(row, i / around * tau, f);
          positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
        }
      }
      return new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3);
    });
    addMorphs(geometry, targets);
  }
  const skin = mesh(parent, name, geometry, material);
  if (shapes.length) movingSkins.push(skin);
  return skin;
}

// A loft row gives the cross-section center and its horizontal and depth radii.
// The animated profiles keep the same rows, so the belly coloring follows the skin.
function shape(rest, rows, depthShift = 0, thicknessScale = 1) {
  return rest.map((row, i) => {
    const [x, y, width, depth = row[2] + depthShift, thickness = row[4] * thicknessScale] = rows[i];
    return [x, y, depth, width, thickness];
  });
}

function bodyTint(x, y, angle) {
  const front = Math.sin(angle);
  const color = gold.clone().lerp(honey, 1 - ease(58, 170, y));
  const underChin = Math.exp(-(((x - 114) / 23) ** 2 + ((y - 76) / 13) ** 2));
  const underArm = Math.exp(-(((x - 150) / 9) ** 2 + ((y - 119) / 33) ** 2));
  color.lerp(ochre, Math.max(0, front) * (0.17 * underChin + 0.27 * underArm));
  if (y >= 108.7 && y <= 171.8 && front > 0) {
    let i = 1;
    while (bellyProfile[i][0] < y) i++;
    const [y0, l0, r0] = bellyProfile[i - 1];
    const [y1, l1, r1] = bellyProfile[i];
    const blend = (y - y0) / (y1 - y0);
    const left = lerp(l0, l1, blend);
    const right = lerp(r0, r1, blend);
    const edge = 0.95 + 0.24 * Math.sin(y * 1.09);
    const mask = ease(left - edge, left + edge, x)
      * (1 - ease(right - edge, right + edge, x))
      * ease(0.04, 0.29, front)
      * ease(108.7, 110.8, y) * (1 - ease(169.5, 171.8, y));
    color.lerp(biscuit.clone().lerp(cream, 0.43 * (1 - ease(111, 175, y))), mask * 0.98);
  }
  return color;
}

function faceDepth(x, y) {

  const cheek = Math.exp(-(((Math.abs(x) - 15.6) / 7.3) ** 2 + ((y + 4) / 13) ** 2));
  const muzzle = Math.exp(-((x / 10) ** 2 + ((y - 10.3) / 5.6) ** 2));
  const brow = Math.exp(-(((Math.abs(x) - 14) / 8) ** 2 + ((y - 20) / 5) ** 2));
  return (headRz + .85 * cheek + 1.28 * muzzle + .58 * brow) *
    Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - r2));
}
function facePoint(x, y, z = faceDepth(x, y)) {
  const skew = x * (1 - .11 * Math.max(0, -y / headRy)) + .036 * y;
  return new THREE.Vector3(skew * unit, y * unit, z * unit);
}

  [1.15,-26.4], [-4.2,-27.1], [-9.2,-23.9], [-12.35,-17.9],
  [-14,-10], [-15.5,-2.4], [-15.8,4.8], [-12.6,8.5], [-6.9,10.2]
].map(([x, y]) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 0)), true, 'centripetal');

function rayRim(x, y) {
  const ox = mouthCenter.x / headRx;
  const oy = mouthCenter.y / headRy;
  const dx = (x - mouthCenter.x) / headRx;
  const dy = (y - mouthCenter.y) / headRy;
  const a = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const b = ox * dx + oy * dy;
  const c = ox * ox + oy * oy - 1;
  const t = (-b + Math.sqrt(b * b - a * c)) / a;
  return [mouthCenter.x + t * dx, mouthCenter.y + t * dy];
}

function jawLift(y, z) {
  return Math.max(0, 9 * unit - y) * ease(-.15, .27, z);
}
function jawMorph(geometry, offset = new THREE.Vector3()) {
  const base = geometry.getAttribute('position');
  const target = new Float32Array(base.count * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < base.count; i++) {
    const x = base.getX(i);
    const y = base.getY(i);
    const z = base.getZ(i);
    const lift = jawLift(y + offset.y, z + offset.z);
    target[3 * i] = x;
    target[3 * i + 1] = y + lift;
    target[3 * i + 2] = z + lift * .18;
  }
  addMorphs(geometry, [new THREE.BufferAttribute(target, 3)]);
  return geometry;
}

  const rimAt = .59;
  if (fraction <= rimAt) {
    const walk = Math.sin(fraction / rimAt * Math.PI / 2);
    x = lerp(lip.x, rimX, walk);
    y = lerp(lip.y, rimY, walk);
    z = faceDepth(x, y) + .9 * Math.exp(-walk * 17) * (1 - walk);
  } else {
    const polar = (fraction - rimAt) / (1 - rimAt) * Math.PI / 2;
    x = rimX * Math.cos(polar);
    y = rimY * Math.cos(polar);
    z = -headRz * Math.sin(polar);

  color.lerp(gold, .27 * (1 - ease(-28, 6, y)));

function eyelid(name, controls, thickness) {
  const eye = group(eyes, name);

  const middle = line.getPoint(.5);

    const positions = [];
    const indices = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 42; i++) {
      const t = i / 42;
      const p = line.getPoint(t);
      const d = line.getTangent(t);
      const w = width * (.11 + .89 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t) ** .68);
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        const x = p.x - d.y * w * side;
        const y = p.y + d.x * w * side + offset;
        const v = facePoint(x, y, faceDepth(x, y) + height).sub(eye.position);
        positions.push(v.x, v.y, v.z);
      }
      const a = 2 * i;
      if (i < 42) indices.push(a, a + 2, a + 1, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3);
    }
    const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
    geometry.setIndex(indices);
    geometry.computeVertexNormals();
    mesh(eye, label, geometry, material);

  trace('dark crescent', lidBlack, thickness, 0, .57);

  const phase = ((t % period) + period) % period;
